verdict.rationale: Gitea documents a public API and webhooks for building custom workflows, and third-party evidence confirms scriptable behavior (e.g., creating private repos via git push without UI/CLI), plus an official CLI (tea) exists. However, probes found no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at the expected docs endpoints, and there's no first-party documentation snippet in the pack showing detailed API reference structure or auth flows. Missing for 10: verifiable OpenAPI/swagger spec discovery, llms.txt or AI-friendly docs, and independent hands-on confirmation of API usage beyond one anecdote.
